configuration.logical_call_accounting: Each plotted method receives T inner calls plus the same 202 boundary calls. Analytic ground truth is not counted.

methods.orbit_greedy: Construct balanced 100-coalition batches in which every player occupies every cyclic position once.
methods.row_greedy: Choose each coalition from a candidate pool to best complement the coalitions already selected.

game.source_note: Configuration reproduced from the supplied paper excerpt.
game.utility: v(S) = max_{i in S} c_i; v(empty) = 0

ground_truth.algorithm: exact threshold-game decomposition: phi_i = sum_{k <= c_i} 1 / count(c_j >= k)
